headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: May 19, 2026**
article:
The Tampa Bay Rays secured a 6-3 victory over the Miami Marlins, while the Baltimore Orioles took down the Washington Nationals 7-3. The Philadelphia Phillies dominated the Pittsburgh Pirates 6-0, and the Atlanta Braves routed the Boston Red Sox 8-1.

Injuries and availability have impacted several teams, with the Colorado Rockies placing left fielder Jordan Beck on the 10-day injured list due to a left hamstring strain. The Los Angeles Dodgers transferred right-handed pitcher Ben Casparius from the 15-day to the 60-day injured list due to right shoulder inflammation. Other teams have also been affected, with the Texas Rangers placing shortstop Corey Seager on the 10-day injured list retroactive to May 15 due to lower back inflammation.

Several trades and roster movements have taken place, including the Los Angeles Dodgers acquiring left-handed pitcher Eric Lauer from the Toronto Blue Jays for cash considerations. The Chicago White Sox acquired center fielder Junior Perez from the Athletics in exchange for left-handed pitcher Jackson Nove. The Athletics also traded right-handed pitcher Kyle Robinson to the Pittsburgh Pirates for second baseman Alika Williams.

top_news.title: **Rays Take Down Marlins 6-3**
top_news.summary: The Tampa Bay Rays secured a 6-3 victory over the Miami Marlins in their latest matchup. Junior Caminero led the Marlins' offense with a home run and 2 RBIs, while Ian Seymour impressed on the mound with a scoreless 0.2 innings pitched.

top_news.title: **Orioles Take Down Nationals 7-3**
top_news.summary: The Baltimore Orioles secured a 7-3 victory over the Washington Nationals, with Gunnar Henderson leading the offense. Henderson's impressive performance included four hits, one home run, and two RBIs.

top_news.title: **Phillies Shut Out Pirates 6-0**
top_news.summary: The Philadelphia Phillies dominated the Pittsburgh Pirates, securing a 6-0 victory. Zack Wheeler led the way on the mound, pitching 7.0 innings with 8 strikeouts and no earned runs.

top_news.title: **Braves Rout Red Sox 8-1**
top_news.summary: The Atlanta Braves dominated the Boston Red Sox, winning 8-1 behind a strong performance from Grant Holmes, who pitched 6.0 innings with 4 strikeouts and 0 earned runs. Austin Riley led the Braves' offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 3 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Rockies Place Jordan Beck on Injured List**
top_news.summary: Colorado Rockies left fielder Jordan Beck has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a left hamstring strain. The injury occurred on May 18, 2026.

top_news.title: **Lauer Joins Dodgers Roster**
top_news.summary: The Los Angeles Dodgers have acquired left-handed pitcher Eric Lauer in a trade with the Toronto Blue Jays. The trade was made for cash considerations.
